If you need to reach me directly:
☎️ Telegram (@hacdias)

🗞 Follow
All pages that list posts, such as micro and articles, have RSS, JSON and HTML (Microformats) feeds. To subscribe to my main posts, you can follow my stream. If you give your RSS reader the page URL, it should be able to automatically pick up the feed.

In case your feed does not detect the feeds automatically, or if you need to access for any other reason, the links are formatted as follows. This example is for the stream page:

HTML/Microformats: https://hacdias.com/stream


RSS Feed: https://hacdias.com/stream/feed.xml


JSON Feed: https://hacdias.com/stream/feed.json

🕸 Elsewhere
My username is usually @hacdias so that’s how you’ll able to find me on almost any social media I’m in. Here are some (possibly) relevant platforms where I’m active:
🐙 GitHub (@hacdias)

📷 Instagram (@hacdias)

🐦 Twitter (@hacdias)

💼 LinkedIn (@hacdias)
